risks.risk: Model/variant mismatch (seller says ZZR; photos don’t clearly confirm the exact ZZR variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/variant badge/label and VIN/engine number plate, plus a full side profile showing the tank/seat/fairing styling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Kawasaki sport bike with unknown exact ZZR variant (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Not actually working despite seller claim (still no start/ride evidence).
risks.proof: Short video: cold start, steady idle, throttle blip, upshift/downshift through gears, and a front+rear brake test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assume potential faults until tested (worst-case: treat as needing inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Brake system may need service (pads/rotor/fluid leaks not verifiable from photos).
risks.proof: Close-ups of brake pads and rotor condition + video braking from low speed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may need service (worst-case: pads/bleed/rotor wear).

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion/damage (photos don’t cover frame underside/engine casing thoroughly).
risks.proof: Photos of frame underside and both engine-side casings in good light; both sides of the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible corrosion/damage present (worst-case: treat as used with maintenance/cosmetic wear).

risks.risk: Original parts claim may be false (aftermarket exhaust/tires/controls not verifiable).
risks.proof: Close-ups of exhaust branding/markings, tire brand/model, and any non-stock components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as parts may be non-original (worst-case: assume aftermarket where not verifiable).

proof_requests: Send a short video of cold start + gear shifting (up/down) + front and rear brake test.
Send clear photos of VIN/engine number plate and the exact ZZR model/variant badge/label.
Send full side profile photos (both sides) and close-ups of tires, brake pads/rotors, and exhaust markings.
response.reason: The seller’s statement that they tested it is not supported by any new photo/video evidence. With the exact ZZR variant and working condition still not verifiable from the provided images, the safest action is to request proof before pricing confidently.
